conclusion.architectureDecision: Keep the formal prototype dependency set unchanged. Reuse the pinned Phaser runtime, Vite browser build tool, and Playwright browser QA only within runs/mobile-chart-adaptation-20260830/workspace/prototype-a. The web-lite output is a browser release candidate and QA artifact, not evidence that WeChat, Douyin, or TapTap packages are publishable; each platform still requires isolated adapter research, build configuration, and device QA.
